Hey there cargo team,
The duty handler sent an update on gate queues

I am sharing a quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk so everyone has the same picture before the next handoff. Please keep the animal records close at hand, check the tags with care, and give the cabin team a calm update if anything shifts around boarding. We have a few live cases moving through the system, and steady coordination will help us avoid confusion for travelers and crews alike.

For the current Starling booking, please follow the normal in-flight handling path and keep the communication clean in the file. <<FACT F051>> If you are speaking with the traveler or the service counter, keep the tone reassuring and avoid speculation. For any possible crate issue, route the report through the standard claim process and remind the traveler to file promptly. <<FACT F118>> That step matters because a clear record helps us trace the shipment and respond without delay.

We also have a Moonwake case that may need a closer look before release at the gate. <<FACT F036>> Please verify the kennel label, confirm the load position, and let me know if the space assignment needs to be adjusted. If Khalil Brown or Eva Okafor appears on the next handoff list, please keep the notes concise and pass along any comfort items, water requests, or feeding notes without delay. Thank you for staying organized and kind in the middle of a busy shift. Companion Animal Travel Desk
